goal: Log Vanilla Bomb pre chill final state
body: NouGen Kitchen relay, Sep 1 2026. Final pre fridge visual for Vanilla Bomb v1: cake fully released from round glass dish, tall central dome intact, browned sidewall and crown, cracked top. Finish applied as Betty Crocker Whipped Butter Cream frosting loosened with Coffee Mate Pumpkin Spice creamer, producing a glossy pour over glaze that ran down the crown and sides and pooled around the base. Toothpicks were inserted into the thick center as doneness probes before chilling. Cake is now going into the refrigerator to set the glaze and crumb. Next checkpoint: post chill cut, interior crumb, moisture, sweetness, vanilla intensity, pumpkin spice balance, and whether the protein powder affected density. Dave is heading to Pollo Tropical while it chills.

relay.note: Logs the pre-fridge visual/finish state of Vanilla Bomb v1 (glossy pumpkin-spice buttercream glaze, toothpick doneness check) ahead of the post-chill taste test. Archival note, no action needed.
